parts.label: tapered photo reconstruction / inferred holes and cup
parts.note: Printed major dimensions constrain a calibrated tapered line/arc contour. Hole centers and cup interpretation are source-linked estimates, not arbitrary constant-width strips. The hollow boss faces the actuator; its floor is inferred at the plate underside. Spline teeth and cosmetic molding dimples are omitted.

assumptions: Photo-based reconstruction, not a manufacturer-controlled drawing or a verified replacement part. Printed decimal places do not establish physical accuracy.
Major length, plate span, axial span and hub span use the photo annotations; tapered contour and hole centers are calibrated inferences recorded per feature.
The printed2.43 local spacing is retained as an annotation, not repeated as a global pitch: it would conflict with the visible hole counts and available arm reach.
The hollow boss opens toward negative localZ, the actuator side. The smooth cup omits teeth; depth and retaining clearance interpretation remain inferred.
Neutral phase, installed shaft height, specimen identity and compatibility with a particular SG90/SG92R/MG90S remain unverified.

observations.note: This photographed specimen is distinct from the AU TA0132 drawing. Double has6 openings per arm; single has7. Paired off-axis dimples are not additional through holes.
Original pixel anchors, lateral hub-span calibration, independent axial normalization and each derived parameter are retained in estimates. No physical error bound is assigned.

The local2.43 label cannot be used as a common pitch with all visible openings and the reported overall length. Single21.3 minus hub6.76 gives14.54 exposed reach, differing from printed14.3 by0.24. These inconsistencies remain explicit rather than silently merging dimensions.

unknown: Exact manufacturer, SKU, physical revision and particular SG90 compatibility.
True spline tooth count/profile, major/minor dimensions, axial stop and mating fit.
Physical uncertainty of the manual photo measurements and perspective-derived contour/centers.
Cosmetic molding dimple depths, edge fillets/draft, true cup floor and installed seating height.

evidence.locator: Rounded end silhouette relative to hub span
evidence.note: Fit circular tips to the photographed rounded silhouette after lateral calibration by reported hub span; regularized to1.90mm(double) or1.96mm(single). Perspective and physical error are not bounded.

evidence.locator: Printed overall length and chosen shaft-centered reconstruction
evidence.note: Double assumes centered equal reaches L/2. Single assumes the rear plan extremity is the reported circular hub radius, so reach=L-D/2.
Tip-center X = inferred reach minus photo-calibrated tip radius.

evidence.locator: Arm width samples along original photograph
evidence.note: Double half-angle3.24deg fitted to observed widths. Single fitted4.89deg is regularized to the common external tangent of hubR3.38 and tipR1.96 at X15.96, about5.10deg. This preserves smooth joins and reported major spans.
Double b=C*tan(alpha)+r/cos(alpha); single b=Rhub/cos(alpha). The arm is tapered, not a constant-width capsule.

evidence.locator: Printed1.45 opening span plus visibly repeated openings
evidence.note: Interpret the printed opening span as a circular linkage-hole diameter and apply it to the visible repeated holes. Diameter convention and physical fit remain unverified.

evidence.locator: Plan and side views of this photograph
evidence.note: Double has six through openings per arm; single has seven. Paired off-axis molded dimples are not through holes.
Interpret as a coaxial circular retaining-clearance opening. No screw thread or fit is inferred.
Represent the visible toothed opening by a smooth visual circular envelope at the annotated span. Teeth, spline major/minor definitions and mating fit are not reconstructed.
Cup opens on the mating side and stops at the underside of the arm plate: depth=reported total height minus reported plate span. Its true floor depth is not measured.
Mirror-average of upper/lower aperture radii after separate affine scales: top15.6/(689.5-344), bottom15.6/(1052-689.5)mm/pixel. Regularized to two decimal places, not a manufacturing tolerance.
